result.summary: The page is mostly well-rendered, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar metadata row. A few minor cosmetic issues (truncated carousel items, an empty filter chip) are also present.

issues.description: In the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery time and delivery fee labels overlap each other, rendering as garbled text like '25–3€0 mdielivery' instead of '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row layout so each label ('25–35 min', '€0 delivery', 'Ramen') occupies its own space with proper separators — e.g., use a horizontal flex container with gap/spacing instead of absolutely positioned or overlapping text elements.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name is cut off mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol...') with no ellipsis, and its card is clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with an ellipsis for long restaurant names, and ensure peeking carousel cards are intentionally styled to indicate horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: An empty, partially visible filter chip appears at the right edge after the 'Healthy' chip, showing a blank pill with no label.
issues.suggestion: Verify the chip list data — remove empty items or ensure the partially visible chip contains its label so users understand more categories exist.

issues.description: The €0 delivery text alignment issue also causes the row baseline to look uneven compared to the rating '4.8 (500+)' on the right side.
issues.suggestion: After fixing the overlap, vertically align the metadata row and the rating on the same baseline for a cleaner appearance.
